look_here_first: Start with the leaves: most are conspicuously 3-lobed or deeply cut, with a long central lobe and smaller lateral lobes; then notice the coarse hispid/glandular plant and multiple terminal or axillary spikes.

key_traits.label: Identification
key_traits.text: coarse perennial, one to several stems, commonly taller than V. canescens

key_traits.label: Identification
key_traits.text: stems and foliage hispid-hirsute with swollen/pustulate hair bases plus short glandular hairs

key_traits.label: Identification
key_traits.text: opposite leaves mostly 3-lobed or deeply cut, with the central lobe conspicuously dominant

key_traits.label: Identification
key_traits.text: leaf margins toothed and principal veins strongly raised below

key_traits.label: Identification
key_traits.text: flowers unevenly spaced along a ridged hairy rachis

key_traits.label: Verbena training
key_traits.text: Separate these by leaf architecture + hair texture + spike/branching architecture before using flower color.
